files.description: Quiz results (80 rows, one per student in seat order, no other columns): quiz_a and quiz_b (points 0-10, whole numbers, many equal values; about 9% and 6% of cells empty for absent students).

task_text: Convert the table to the best-fitting column types after reading, so that the scores stay whole numbers with empty cells. Rank the students in quiz_a from the lowest score (rank 1 = lowest; equal scores share the average of their ranks; absent students get no rank). Give the ranks of the students who scored 9 or 10 points in quiz_a. `result` should be a Series of ranks indexed by row position (0 = first student in the file), in file order.
intended_computation: Average ascending ranks of the 73 non-empty quiz_a scores; keep the 8 students with quiz_a 9 or 10, indexed by their 0-based row position.

acceptable_variants.notes: ranks may be decimals or whole numbers.

predicted_direction.reason: On 2.x rank() on the nullable column gave the absent students ranks below everybody, so every present student's rank rose by 7; on 3.x absent students stay unranked, as the task asks.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row N06; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
